step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Failure to provide entitlement information.”

Details: Type “No return call from the client. 15 - Claim Procedure disentitlement imposed for failure to provide entitlement information. Information is missing. Cannot input allocation of pension benefits.”
Select Save .
If the claim is terminated but can be reactivated, select the appropriate BPC on the Dormant tab and select Reactivate . Go to step 7.
If the claim is active, go to step 8.
If the claim is converted to MPS, note that a D15 from the Monday of the renewal week must be included in the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction to IPOC. Go to step 9.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the AI WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Reactivation of BPC [XXXX].”
Bring forward date: Enter today’s date + one business day.
When the WI moves to the current workload, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlement (M161) transaction and impose the D15 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the renewal registration number.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select 15 - Claim procedure .
Start date: Enter the Monday of the renewal week.
End date: Select Indefinite .
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .
Go to step 12.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the renewal registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the allocation.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “Input renewal w/c [XXXX], CT [XX].”
Remarks lines 2–4: Type “D15 from w/c [XXXX-X] to 9999.” Include all other information required for the renewal, if necessary.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the renewal registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Disentitlements (2976)
D48 and D15 — Moved — Address unknown and claim procedure (3006) .
D15 - Claim procedure (3009)
D15 - Text: Insert appropriate reason for D15
We / In addition, we
Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485)
Indefinite disentitlement start date (1270)
Text - Insert appropriate reason(s) (1618): Type the appropriate option:
“you have not returned our call[s] following the message[s] left on [date[s]].”
“you have not contacted us following the letter sent to you on [date].”

step.cmd: Return to the appropriate renewal task
